name: Prestige Evergreen
location: SH 35, Whitefield Main Road, Varthur, Bengaluru 560087
tagline: Life, in all its beautiful ways
overview: Prestige Evergreen sits within Prestige Raintree Park off Varthur Main Road, co-located with Prestige Tech Forest — a 2.5 Mn.sft IT tech park — in Bengaluru's new East CBD. The development spans 14 residential towers (Buildings 01–07) with 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes, an extensive multi-level clubhouse, and a landscaped master plan built around a central lagoon and lap pool.
highlights: Co-located with Prestige Tech Forest, a 2.5 Mn.sft IT tech park — a commute-free lifestyle
Multi-level clubhouse with indoor family pool, squash and badminton courts, co-working space
Landscaped master plan with infinity lap pool, lagoon, water courtyard and forest pavilion
Tennis, pickleball, padel, cricket practice pitch and basketball courts on-site
Work hubs within 3 km: Sigma Tech Park, Brigade IRV Center
Schools within 3 km: Glentree Academy, Vibgyor School
Hospitals within 3 km: Manipal Hospital, Vydehi Super Speciality Hospital
amenities: Infinity lap pool, lagoon & kids pool
Table tennis, pool table & virtual cricket
Rain Tree Grove trail & forest pavilion
Water courtyard, sunken deck & sculpture garden
